in_hebrew.name: Henrique
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Henrique הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Germanic name Henricus, meaning 'ruler of the home'. The name Henrique is of Portuguese origin and translates to 'Henry'. It is derived from the Old Germanic elements 'hein' (home, family) and 'ric' (ruler, power). In Christian tradition, the name is associated with the saint and Emperor Henry II, known for his strong leadership and devotion to God.
